facts.text: For the bowling alley with Gus and Ralph.
facts.why: Wikipedia has Phil getting drunk with locals Gus and Ralph, and the bowling alley scene is where they are. The line names no drink in the film, so it claims nothing the film contradicts.

facts.text: Phil orders it with everything else
facts.why: Wikipedia only has Phil binge eating in the loops, and the script has the diner serving coffee and sticky buns. Nothing names angel food cake.
facts.fix: Part of Phil's binge at the diner

vibe.verdict: A spot-on Tip Top Cafe, with Ned and the diner binge used well, but the diner template look is generic.
